text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
How was it, my running? It was my absolute 
best so far, right?
choice_data_list:
You really looked like you were having 
fun.

You really looked like you were having so 
much fun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I wonder if this might be the first 
time I've ever run with the throttle wide 
open like this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the excitement reached all the 
fans and juniors who were watching!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, up ahead is finally the Classic year. 
Even more exciting races are waiting for 
us!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you're aiming for the Classic 
races, right?

Judging by today's performance, there's no 
doubt she can hold her own in the 
Classics.

So, the next target race is said to be a 
prelude to the Classic route—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I see, we take it step by step, right. Got 
it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm already looking forward to 
seeing what kind of race it'll be♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, looks like I've got an 
interview, so see you later!

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ngh... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You did great! Here, drink some water and 
calm down...!

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... T-Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She's far, far stronger... than the rumors 
said... She's like... a monster...

And so, a few days after finishing running 
on the grand stage—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san! Your last race was wicked 
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just watching had me completely thrilled! 
So after that, I went and ran lap after 
lap all by myself!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan, calm down. Take a deep breath~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! Inhaaaale... inhaaaale... 
inhaaa—*cough* *hack*!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san, that was truly the best race. 
I feel like you've shown me the ideal I 
should strive for.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I'm honored. I'll keep showing you 
my absolute best running♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll take notes and learn~

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there she is! Maruzensky-san, please 
let us interview you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Please tell us about your magnificent run 
in the Asahi Hai!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aaaalright, sounds good to me~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa... There are so many reporters...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she really is a senior we should look 
up to.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Good work, Trainer-kun.
choice_data_list:
Good work on the interview over there, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Good work, Trainer-chan.
choice_data_list:
Good work on the interview over there, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, with all the interviews today, 
we couldn't even do proper training.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, it doesn't feel bad, but man, I 
really wanted to blast it further~

She's dying to run—right now, she seems to 
be enjoying running from the bottom of her 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? The one over there... is that who I 
ran with in the Asahi Hai...?

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I have something I'd like to 
consult with you about regarding the next 
race...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? You're acting so formal...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She was conscious of me and challenged me 
in the Asahi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I worked super hard in training!" "I'm 
not gonna lose!" ...like that.
choice_data_list: You're a precious rival to me.
You're a precious rival to me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Rivals...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, rivals! That's why it was so 
much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, she seems a bit down in the 
dumps...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Maybe I'll cheer them on like a 
proper rival♪

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... For the upcoming Spring Stakes, 
please let me sit this one out...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text: Evade it... are you serious...plate?!

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I heard Maruzensky-san is planning to 
run... I know it's terrible to sound so 
weak-kneed, but...

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Running when you know you can't win ...is 
so painful.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Is her running truly so incredible that 
it makes even you say something like 
that...?"

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Let's enter the race that 
suits you best right now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Dropping out just because I'm 
running...

While Maruzensky's running captivated 
many, it seemed to leave a different kind 
of impression on her fellow competitors.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha...! Each and every race is 
precious to an Umamusume, after all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural to be careful when 
choosing which races to enter! Let's take 
a page out of their book!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, this is where I get off! 
Trainer-kun, see you tomorrow~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, this is where I get off! 
Trainer-chan, see you tomorrow~!

The sight of Maruzensky leaving as if 
running away looked completely different 
from her usual, joyful running back.
